title: A Foundation Model to Measure and Predict Human Behaviour
abstract: arXiv:2611.24830v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to infer psychological attributes, predict individual behaviour, and simulate human populations. However, despite generating plausible responses, they often misrepresent individuals and distort population statistics. Here we introduce Chiron, a foundation model to measure and predict human behaviour. We jointly fine-tune an LLM to represent psychological constructs, predict individual behaviour, and align population response distributions with human statistics. The training and evaluation data span 36 behavioural domains and 78 social science experiments, comprising 288,307 person records, 1,411,750 atomic behavioural decisions, and 99,953 psychometric assessments over 109 psychological constructs. translated_title: 测量与预测人类行为的基础模型
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）正被越来越多地用于推断心理属性、预测个体行为和模拟人类群体。然而，尽管它们能生成看似合理的回应，却常常错误地呈现个体并扭曲群体统计特征。在此，我们提出了Chiron，一个用于测量和预测人类行为的基础模型。我们联合微调一个LLM，使其能够表征心理构念、预测个体行为，并使群体回应分布与人类统计数据保持一致。训练和评估数据涵盖36个行为领域和78项社会科学实验，包含288,307条个体记录、1,411,750个原子行为决策，以及针对109个心理构念的99,953项心理测量评估。在评估中，Chiron的心理测量结果与人类自我报告更为吻合，且表现出更少损害心理测量效度的偏差。它对个体行为的预测...
tldr: 本文提出名为Chiron的行为基础模型，通过对LLM进行联合微调以表征心理构念、预测个体行为并对齐群体回应分布与人类统计数据，从而在心理测量上更贴近人类自我报告且偏差更少。
